files.test_cache.py:
import unittest
from src.cache import TTLCache
class CacheTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def make(self, ttl=5):
        clock=[10.0]
        return TTLCache(ttl,lambda:clock[0]),clock
    def test_missing(self):
        cache,clock=self.make()
        marker=[]
        self.assertIs(cache.get("missing",marker),marker)
    def test_normal(self):
        cache,clock=self.make()
        cache.set("a",{"n":1})
        clock[0]=14.9
        self.assertEqual(cache.get("a"),{"n":1})
    def test_exact_deadline(self):
        cache,clock=self.make()
        cache.set("a",1)
        clock[0]=15.0
        self.assertIsNone(cache.get("a"))
    def test_after_deadline(self):
        cache,clock=self.make()
        cache.set("a",1)
        clock[0]=100.0
        self.assertEqual(cache.get("a","gone"),"gone")
    def test_zero_ttl(self):
        cache,clock=self.make(0)
        cache.set("a",1)
        self.assertIsNone(cache.get("a"))
    def test_invalid_ttl(self):
        for ttl in [-1,float("nan"),float("inf"),True,"5",None]:
            with self.subTest(ttl=ttl):
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError): TTLCache(ttl)
    def test_set_snapshot(self):
        cache,clock=self.make()
        value={"items":[1]}
        cache.set("a",value)
        value["items"].append(2)
        self.assertEqual(cache.get("a"),{"items":[1]})
    def test_get_snapshot(self):
        cache,clock=self.make()
        cache.set("a",{"items":[1]})
        result=cache.get("a")
        result["items"].append(2)
        self.assertEqual(cache.get("a"),{"items":[1]})
    def test_overwrite(self):
        cache,clock=self.make()
        cache.set("a",1)
        clock[0]=12
        cache.set("a",2)
        clock[0]=16
        self.assertEqual(cache.get("a"),2)
    def test_nested_lists(self):
        cache,clock=self.make()
        cache.set("a",[{"x":[1]}])
        result=cache.get("a")
        result[0]["x"].append(3)
        self.assertEqual(cache.get("a"),[{"x":[1]}])
if __name__=="__main__": unittest.main()

files.CONTRACT.md: TTLCache(ttl_seconds, clock=None) accepts a finite non-negative int or float TTL, excluding bool. Invalid TTL raises ValueError. set(key,value) stores a deep snapshot with deadline clock()+ttl. get(key, default=None) returns default at or after deadline and for missing keys, otherwise a deep snapshot. Returning or mutating a result must not change stored data. Preserve constructor/set/get signatures and injected clock. Default clock is monotonic.
